maison.label: The Maison
maison.heading: CIELO is a luxury maison.
maison.p1: We do not sell art. We complete spaces — through large-scale works of extraordinary presence, each produced in an edition of three, each registered, certified, and permanently associated with the room it enters.
maison.p2: The rooms in which we live and work carry meaning. A lobby communicates before anyone speaks. A private residence reveals its owner before a word is exchanged. When something is missing from a space — not furniture, not light, but the final word — CIELO provides it.

works.label: The Collection
works.heading: Works of Enduring Presence
works.emptyBody: Current works are presented privately, in the gallery, by appointment. Those interested in beginning a correspondence with the maison are invited to inquire below.

materials.label: Materials & Production
materials.heading: Surface. Light. Space.
materials.intro: Two substrates. Two spatial characters. The choice between them is not technical — it is a question of what the room requires.
materials.m1Body: UV-cured ink is fixed into acrylic at depth. Light does not fall upon it — it enters, refracts, and returns changed. In a hotel lounge at evening, in a private room at noon, the work reads differently each hour. Not a photograph on a wall. A luminous object that belongs to the room.
materials.m2Body: Flat. Dense. Without warmth, without concession. The aluminum composite surface reads as a panel of the building itself — not hung on the wall but continuous with it. For lobbies, corridors, and institutional spaces that require absolute restraint.
materials.fmtStdDesc: For the private study, the secondary reception space. A presence that anchors a wall with authority while leaving the room's proportions intact.
materials.fmtGrandDesc: The principal format. For drawing rooms, hotel corridors, the lobbies of private institutions. At Grand scale, the work does not share the wall — it defines it.
materials.fmtSigDesc: By private arrangement. For double-height lobbies, monumental corridors, the principal spaces of flagship properties. Dimensions by direct consultation.
materials.installHeading: The maison arrives. The room is completed.
materials.install1Desc: Works are transported in crating specified for each work's dimensions and weight. Third-party logistics are not offered.
materials.install2Desc: Installed by personnel designated by the maison, with hardware appropriate to wall type, substrate, and scale. The client is not asked to arrange installation.
materials.install3Desc: Where placement has not been confirmed, the maison provides on-site consultation to assess the room and determine the position in which the work truly belongs.
materials.install4Desc: The installation is complete when the work is right. Not when it is hung — when the room has become what it was always meant to be.

registry.label: The Registry
registry.heading: Every work, registered once.
registry.p1: Each CIELO work exists in an edition of three. No more. Each edition is registered in the CIELO Ownership Registry — a permanent, maison-maintained record associating the work with its owner, verifiable at any point in the future through both a physical certificate and an authenticated reference.
registry.p2: Ownership of a CIELO work is not merely the possession of an object. It is entry into a record that will outlast both the room and the people in it.
registry.pillar1Body: A physical document bearing the work title, edition number, dimensions, production year, and the maison seal. Presented in a black clamshell case. Not a receipt — a declaration.
registry.pillar2Body: Each work carries its edition designation permanently — I of III, II of III, III of III. The number is not decorative. It is structural. It is the reason the work holds the value it holds.
registry.pillar3Body: Maison-maintained, permanently accessible to the registered owner. When ownership transfers, the record transfers with it. The history of every CIELO work belongs to the work, not to any single owner.
registry.certFooter: This certificate is issued by CIELO and permanently associated with the CIELO Ownership Registry. It may be verified at any point in the future through the maison's authentication system.
registry.transferBody: When a CIELO work changes ownership, the registry record is updated through a formal maison process. The new owner receives a reissued certificate carrying both the original registry number and the transfer notation.

membership.label: Membership
membership.heading: The patron relationship.
membership.p1: Those who acquire CIELO works enter an ongoing relationship with the maison — one that deepens over time, through correspondence, through private access, through the accumulated knowledge of your spaces and what they require.
membership.p2: There are no programmes. No points. No thresholds to meet before you are treated as someone the maison knows. From the first acquisition, you are known.
membership.p3: As the relationship develops — as your collection grows, as the maison comes to understand your world more fully — the access deepens.

silver.name: Silver
silver.character: The beginning of a considered relationship

consultation.label: Private Concierge
consultation.heading: A room with something missing.
consultation.body: Consultations are held in the CIELO gallery, by appointment. They are private — one patron, the correspondent, and the works the maison has prepared in response to your space.
consultation.privacy: This correspondence is private. CIELO does not share client information with any third party.
consultation.error: The correspondence could not be sent.

world.label: The World
world.heading: Tokyo. Paris.
world.body: Works are available to clients internationally. Correspondence may be opened from anywhere. All inquiries are personal. All responses are private.

maisonStructure.subL1: CIELO is a maison. ASIA VISION LINK is its foundation.
maisonStructure.subL2: The distinction is precise. The commitment is singular.
maisonStructure.cieloDesc: The patron-facing identity. Every work registered, every installation considered, every ownership relationship maintained in perpetuity. The maison speaks only in the language of enduring presence.
maisonStructure.avlDesc: The operating company. Responsible for legal, contractual, and institutional structures — ensuring the maison exists at the standard it demands. Invisible in the gallery. Present in the foundation.
maisonStructure.d01Body: Large-scale works in strict editions of three, installed by the maison in the spaces they complete.
maisonStructure.d02Body: Consultative placement for residences, hospitality properties, and institutions of genuine ambition.
maisonStructure.d03Body: The CIELO Ownership Registry — a permanent, maison-maintained record of works, editions, and provenance.
maisonStructure.d04Body: Private events, preview evenings, and gallery programming conducted to the standard of luxury hospitality.
maisonStructure.d05Body: The CIELO gallery, Ginza Tokyo — maintained continuously, accessible by private appointment.
maisonStructure.d06Body: Proprietary technology enabling patrons to visualise a work within their specific architectural space.
maisonStructure.closingCredit: ASIA VISION LINK — Operating CIELO, a luxury maison.
